definition.name: Signal Garden
definition.description: A botanical visualization of real earthquake records. Remap stem height, bloom size, and petal color; inspect each specimen or reuse the dataset. Run to refresh. No API key required.

params.template:
SUBFORK / BOTANICAL DATA STUDIES / 02

Signal Garden.

Every record, a flower. The same world, seen differently.

Reading dataset...
-- FLOWERS

Field notes

Select a flower to inspect the record behind it.

Specimen index

Run the graph again to refresh the snapshot. Growth and swaying are visual metaphors, not real-time measurements or forecasts. Layout is deterministic. Field scales use the displayed records; position and petal count are decorative.

template.summary: Reusable SVG garden from a normalized dataset, initially wired to the same USGS rows as Planet Pulse.
